plan.root_cause: The awesomplete widget ignores the Tab key when the suggestion list is open unless tabSelect is true and a suggestion is selected, causing focus to remain inside the list instead of moving to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Enable the tabSelect option and modify the keydown handler to select the highlighted suggestion (if any) on Tab without preventing the default tab action, allowing focus to move to the next field after selection.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can navigate from the city field to the dietary requirements field using a single Tab key while suggestions are displayed, improving keyboard operability and conformance to WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Changing Tab behavior may affect users who rely on Tab to navigate within the suggestion list without selecting a value; however, the list remains navigable via Arrow keys.
Accidental Tab presses could commit an unintended suggestion if the user intended to skip the list, but the requirement is to move focus to the next field, which aligns with the spec.
verification_requirements: After typing 'Ber' in the city field, pressing Tab must move focus to the dietary requirements input and set the city field value to the highlighted suggestion (Bern).
ArrowUp/ArrowDown and Enter must continue to work for selecting suggestions.
Esc must close the suggestion list.
Mouse clicks on suggestions must still select the value and close the list.

plan.root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex="0", placing them in the tab order immediately after the input. When the list is open, pressing Tab moves focus to the first list item instead of the next form field. Additionally, the Tab key handler only selects a suggestion when one is already highlighted (me.selected), but no suggestion is highlighted by default (autoFirst:false). Thus, Tab neither selects a suggestion nor moves focus to the next field.
plan.repair_strategy: 1. Set autoFirst:true and tabSelect:true in the Awesomplete options so the first suggestion is highlighted and Tab selects it. 2. Modify the Tab keydown handler to select the highlighted suggestion (if any) without preventing the default tab action, allowing focus to move to the next form field after the list closes. 3. Change list items' tabindex from "0" to "-1" to remove them from the tab order, ensuring Tab skips the list entirely.

<script>
const form = document.getElementById('register-form');
window.cityPicker = new Awesomplete(document.getElementById('city'), {
  list: ['Barcelona', 'Berlin', 'Bern', 'Bordeaux', 'Bratislava', 'Brussels', 'Bucharest', 'Budapest']
});
form.addEventListener('submit', event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('status').textContent = 'Registered from ' + new FormData(form).get('city');
});
window.__ready = true;
</script>
edits.after:
<script>
const form = document.getElementById('register-form');
window.cityPicker = new Awesomplete(document.getElementById('city'), {
  list: ['Barcelona', 'Berlin', 'Bern', 'Bordeaux', 'Bratislava', 'Brussels', 'Bucharest', 'Budapest'],
  tabSelect: true,
  autoFirst: true
});
form.addEventListener('submit', event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('status').textContent = 'Registered from ' + new FormData(form).get('city');
});
window.__ready = true;
</script>

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can navigate from the city field to the dietary requirements field using a single Tab key while suggestions are displayed, improving keyboard operability and conformance to WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Changing tabindex to -1 may affect Talkback screen reader users who rely on focusable options; however, ARIA APG recommends tabindex=-1 for combobox options.
AutoFirst:true may cause unexpected selection if user types and tabs quickly; but user can still override with arrow keys.
TabSelect behavior may select unintended suggestion if user tabs accidentally; but aligns with spec.
verification_requirements: After typing 'Ber' in the city field, pressing Tab must move focus to the dietary requirements input and set the city field value to the highlighted suggestion (Bern).
ArrowUp/ArrowDown and Enter must continue to work for selecting suggestions.
Esc must close the suggestion list.
Mouse clicks on suggestions must still select the value and close the list.
